words.definition: A machine used for carrying people or goods.

contextSentences.en: The self-driving vehicle uses cameras and sensors to detect obstacles on the road.
Any vehicle weighing more than 3.5 tonnes is classified as a heavy goods vehicle.

words.definition: A machine that produces power to move a vehicle.

contextSentences.en: An internal combustion engine generates power by burning fuel inside its cylinders.
An overheated engine can cause serious and costly damage to a vehicle.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how engine works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje motor.

words.definition: A transport system that uses trains on tracks.

contextSentences.en: The first railway in Germany ran between Nuremberg and Fürth in 1835.
High-speed railway lines like the ICE connect major cities in just a few hours.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how railway works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje železnica.

words.definition: A place where trains or buses regularly stop.

contextSentences.en: Berlin Central Station is one of the most modern and busiest railway stations in Europe.
Departure boards at the station display real-time information about delays and platform changes.

words.definition: The raised area beside the track where passengers board a train.

contextSentences.en: For safety reasons, passengers must stay behind the yellow line on the platform.
The long platform can accommodate several trains stopping at the same time.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of platform yesterday.

words.definition: Goods carried by ship, aircraft, or vehicle.

contextSentences.en: Hazardous cargo such as chemicals must be clearly labelled and securely stored during transport.
The cargo was thoroughly inspected for damage before being loaded onto the ship.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of cargo yesterday.

words.definition: The transport of goods in large quantities.

contextSentences.en: Rail freight is significantly more environmentally friendly than road haulage.
International freight is often transported through major seaports before moving inland.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term freight.

words.definition: The movement of vehicles on roads.

contextSentences.en: The new bypass road is designed to reduce traffic congestion in the town centre.
Smart traffic light systems can adjust signals in real time to ease congestion.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how traffic works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje premávka.

words.definition: An underground or enclosed passage for transport.

contextSentences.en: The Gotthard Base Tunnel in Switzerland is the longest railway tunnel in the world at 57 km.
Building the tunnel required the most advanced drilling machines available.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how tunnel works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje tunel.

words.definition: A structure built to carry a road or railway over an obstacle.

contextSentences.en: The Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco is one of the most iconic suspension bridges in the world.
Engineers are planning a new bridge to connect two parts of the city that are currently hard to reach.

words.definition: A strip at an airport where aircraft take off and land.

contextSentences.en: The runway at the new airport is long enough to handle the world's largest passenger aircraft.
Due to icy conditions, the runway was closed for several hours and all flights were cancelled.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how runway works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje vzletová a pristávacia dráha.

words.definition: A sheltered place where ships can stay safely.

contextSentences.en: The Port of Rotterdam handles millions of shipping containers every year.
Historic harbour cities like Venice owed their wealth to maritime trade.

words.definition: A plan that shows times of departures and arrivals.

contextSentences.en: The bus schedule was revised to offer more frequent services in the evenings.
Technical problems can make it impossible to stick to the schedule temporarily.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of schedule yesterday.
words.example_sk: Včera sme študovali pojem cestovný poriadok.

words.definition: The path or direction followed from one place to another.

contextSentences.en: The ICE train travels at up to 300 km/h on the route between Frankfurt and Munich.
The route through the mountains is technically demanding due to its many curves and tunnels.

words.example_en: The route is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Trasa je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: To travel regularly between home and work or school.

contextSentences.en: More and more people choose to commute by bicycle to reduce their carbon footprint.
Studies show that the average person who commutes by car spends over 40 minutes per journey.
